meta.description: Refrigerator, washer and dryer repair across Austin and nearby cities. Upfront pricing, same-day visits and a 90-day warranty on every appliance repair service.

overview: One local team for the appliances your household depends on. Find yours below and see how we fix it.

servicesBlock.intro: Every service page covers the problems we fix, how a visit works and what it costs.

locationsBlock.intro: Our technicians cover these counties and cities from our Austin shop.
locationsBlock.closing: Don't see your city? Send us your address and we will confirm coverage the same day.

faqHeading: Questions About Our Appliance Repair Services

faq.a: We repair refrigerators, washers and dryers, including built-in and premium refrigerators.

faq.q: Can one visit cover two appliances?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us about both when you book so we plan enough time.
No. We repair appliances only, so our advice on repair versus replacement has no sales angle.
There is a service call fee, waived when you approve the repair, and you get the repair price in writing first.

faq.q: Is it worth repairing an older appliance?
faq.a: Often it is. The technician compares the repair price with replacement so you can decide.

faqClosing: Still have a question? Our FAQ page covers scheduling, pricing and warranty.

closing.body: Appliance repair in Austin and nearby cities, priced before we start and backed for 90 days.
